name: Orange Money Mali

documents: Trade and Personal Property Credit Register

sources.quote: These merchants just have to sign up for our solution in an Orange store in their country of business. They must be officially registered retailers (Orange Money merchants - fully KYA compliant)*.
Don't forget to provide full documentation i.e. Trade and Personal Property Credit Register or other documents as per local legislation.
Companies that hold the Orange Money merchant status can access this service.

open_questions: Orange's developer pages (all countries) require the Orange Money merchant status, obtained in an Orange store, and refer to the local operator for its rules; Orange Mali's site (orangemali.com) has no page saying whether an individual without a registered business can become an Orange Money merchant in Mali.

description: Orange Money is the leading mobile money operator in West and Central Africa. The Orange Money Web Payment API lets merchants generate hosted payment pages from a server-side Bearer token obtained via OAuth2 client_credentials. This spec covers the Mali (ML) endpoint; the same API shape is exposed per country under /orange-money-webpay/{country}/v1/webpayment.
example_prompt: Add Orange Money Mali web payment to my checkout: obtain a Bearer token via OAuth2, create a hosted payment session, redirect the user to the returned payment_url, then verify the payment server-side from the notif_url callback before fulfilling the order.
